title: Your Unused PTO Is a $4,200 Gift to Your Boss
hook: 55% of workers give their vacation days back to their employer every year — and that's worth $4,200 of your own earned pay, handed over for free.
angle: Most finance content ignores PTO as a form of compensation. Framing unused vacation as a voluntary pay cut to your employer is contrarian and specific.
audience: Full-time employees with paid vacation benefits who routinely skip days off out of guilt or fear
key_numbers: $4,200 average value of unused PTO per worker annually
55% of workers don't use all their vacation days
768 million vacation days left unused across America each year
40% productivity boost for workers who take full vacation
30% higher heart disease risk for men who skip vacations
